title: To Remember
text:
Title: To Remember

I shot my first roll of film when I was in Class 6 on a store-bought plastic camera. A senior I liked had asked if 
I would photograph her best friend’s birthday party. I agreed, not knowing how to use a film camera or load and 
shoot film. There was no one to teach me and the internet didn’t exist—at least not for us, in the South Indian 
town of Madurai in the early 2000s. We were still learning how to make a small triangle move 
upwards and sideways in computer class, and I only paid attention because I had a massive crush on the teacher. But I digress.
